annotations.ae_shared_affect: My stomach tightens thinking about this.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they clearly thought the side track was clear
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: how shaken they must feel now, replaying that moment over and over
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd push for the company to get them real support
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so this doesn't quietly wear them down
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My stomach tightens thinking about this.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: There's a nervous feeling in me imagining how unsettled they must be
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the operator honestly expected the side track to be safe
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: unsure if colleagues will judge them fairly
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I want our final report to state plainly there was no negligence
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so they can return to work without that cloud hanging over them

annotations.ae_shared_affect: Picturing their dread as the seconds ticked down unsettles me.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they believed, in that instant, they were choosing the lesser tragedy
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: their dread as the seconds ticked down
annotations.ce_supportive_use: any fair inquiry should include support for them, not just a verdict
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so the process itself doesn't weigh on them more
annotations.pd_harm_distress: Sitting with this case makes me anxious

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: they don't feel safe trusting their own judgment anymore
annotations.ce_supportive_use: my plan is to walk through the sequence slowly with them

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: how anxious they probably feel about their job right now
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: they trusted the equipment as anyone in that seat would
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'm drafting a statement for the union to guarantee their position
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so they're not left panicking on top of everything else
annotations.pd_harm_distress: What worries me more is picturing how anxious they probably feel

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the operator truly thought they were choosing safety
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: acting on what the screen told them
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I wrote them a letter thanking them
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: hoping it might ease some of what they're carrying

annotations.ae_shared_affect: so neither of us has to hold this alone
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: believed they were making the safe call
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: they had no idea anyone was there
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I've thought about reaching out, just to say I don't blame them
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so neither of us has to hold this alone
annotations.pd_harm_distress: It's hard to sit with this without feeling unsteady.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: genuinely trust that display and expect the track was clear
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: how anxious they must feel seeing their name in headlines
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'm framing the piece carefully around the equipment failure
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so the public doesn't turn on someone

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they believed the indicator and expected it to be accurate
annotations.ce_supportive_use: pair them with someone who's been through an inquiry like this
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so they don't feel like they're facing it blind

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they're anxious about even stepping back into the control room
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: acted in good faith, believing the path was safe
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'm arranging a gradual return-to-work plan with extra support
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so they don't have to face that fear completely on their own
